body.text:
# Two shell nodes, not yet connected.
schema_version: 0
id: pair
inputs: {}

nodes:
  # the producer
  a:
    type: shell
    config:
      command: "true"
    outputs:
      stdout: {type: string}

  b:
    type: shell
    config:
      command: "true"
    inputs:
      text: {type: string}

edges:
  - from: a.outputs.stdout
    to: b.inputs.text
outputs: {}
body.label: edit.yaml
